evidence.note: Authentication record declares only an Aad block (AuthorizationUri, Resource, DefaultClientApplication). No key, username-password, anonymous, or custom OAuth flow is implemented in the connector.
Data tables are read through Sql.Database(validatedServer, database, sqlOptions).
Web.Contents(BapEndpoint) is a live request that lists environments for the navigation table.
Web.Contents call to the Dataverse api/data endpoint to read the WWW-Authenticate header for the AAD authorization URI.
Parameter 'server' (optional text) names the Dataverse host, for example orgname.crm.dynamics.com; this is url-or-server.
Parameter 'options' (optional nullable record) is the connector settings record, which is options-record.
The database name is derived from the server host, so the user supplies no separate database or resource id.

options-fields.text: Accepts CreateNavigationProperties (nullable logical, default true; read at line 71). Two hidden fields are also validated by OptionsMap: EnableDisplayNames (nullable logical, default true; read at line 70) and UnsafeTypeConversions (nullable logical, default false). Any other key is rejected by ValidateOptions.

evidence.note: Declares the accepted options: CreateNavigationProperties, EnableDisplayNames (hidden), and UnsafeTypeConversions (hidden).
Reads EnableDisplayNames and CreateNavigationProperties from validated options.
One Web.Contents/Json.Document call; no nextLink or skip-token loop.
Json.Document parses the BAP environment list that becomes the navigation table returned to the user (json).
Sql.Database driver returns the entity tables as rows (driver-rows).
Hardcoded table type with M types for DisplayName, Name, Location, IsDefault, and Data.
Table.FromRecords(locations, EnvironmentListType) applies the declared type.
Sql.Database supplies names and types for the entity tables; only captions are adjusted (AdjustTypeForCaptions keeps the underlying types).
Table.FromRecords with the declared EnvironmentListType keeps the declared columns even when the environment list is empty.
Live Web.Contents(BapEndpoint) data request with no ManualStatusHandling, so Power Query handles status codes.
ManualStatusHandling={401} is set on the Web.Contents call, and the WWW-Authenticate response header is inspected manually.
Documentation.Name, Caption, and LongDescription are set on the function type.
Documentation.FieldCaption is set on the parameters and options (FieldDescription at lines 105 and 110).
Documentation.SampleValues is set for CreateNavigationProperties (true) and server (orgname.crm.dynamics.com).
Navigator rows are listed at runtime from the BAP environments API.
NavigationTable.SupportsIndirection is set, so environment rows are indirect.
Each environment's Data re-invokes CommonDataService.Database(endpoint), which returns the entity navigation table.
TestConnection returns the shared CommonDataService.Database with ServerFromPath(path), so the test runs the normal entry function.
Folding is delegated to Sql.Database (source-function-folding).
Table.View with an OnNativeQuery handler that calls Value.NativeQuery (native-query).
SqlDatabase.View declares NativeQueryOptions EnableFolding and PreserveTypes; no OnTake, OnSelectRows, or similar folding handlers are written.

native-query-enabled.text: Enabled by an OnNativeQuery handler on the Table.View wrapping Sql.Database. The handler calls Value.NativeQuery on navTable, or on a SqlDatabase.View whose NativeQueryOptions include EnableFolding, and it reads the EnableFolding and DisplayNames options.

evidence.note: OnNativeQuery handler calling Value.NativeQuery; options EnableFolding and DisplayNames are read.
NativeQueryOptions {"EnableFolding","PreserveTypes"} are declared.
The connector is one .pq file with no pqm modules.
Extension.LoadString supplies localized captions, descriptions, and button text.
Extension.Contents loads Dataverse PNG icons at multiple sizes.
No Diagnostics.Trace call appears in the file.
A single synchronous request; no job polling or export is started.
No Action functions or table mutations are defined.
